title: GB F-gas company certification QA controls

sources.title: Company certification to work with F gas
Fluorinated gas (F gas): guidance for users, producers and traders

facts.source_fact: Companies including sole traders must be certified to service specified stationary F-gas equipment operated by others.
Covered stationary equipment includes air conditioning, refrigeration and fire protection.
Company certification covers installation, repair, maintenance and decommissioning of covered equipment.
A company must employ enough trained staff for the work.
A company must have a written procedure for safe F-gas handling and emissions minimisation.
Certification bodies may audit companies for compliance.
A company servicing only its own equipment does not need company certification under the stated example.
Individuals handling F gas still require personal qualifications even where company certification is not required.
Company certification is not required for specified categories such as refrigerated trucks/trailers, high-voltage switchgear and certain mobile air conditioning.
Certification status is a compliance attribute, not a direct greenhouse-gas measurement.
